analysis: Recency-weighted MultVAE executed successfully but did not improve validation performance: host macro HR@10 was 0.5212 versus the prior 0.535. Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.560, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.535, Electronics 0.325, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.665. Electronics declined from 0.355. This trial provides no evidence that emphasizing recent interactions improves this reconstruction model; the half-life of 10 interactions may suppress useful older preferences, but the results do not establish the cause.
code_summary: Per-category sparse MultVAE with a 256-unit encoder, 64-dimensional Gaussian latent variable, and tanh decoder. History occurrence weights decay with a 10-interaction half-life, aggregate repeated items, and receive L2 normalization before 0.5 input dropout and weighted EmbeddingBag pooling. Reconstruction targets remain binary unique observed items. Training uses multinomial reconstruction plus annealed KL, Adam at 1e-3, and validation HR@10 checkpoint selection with NDCG@10 breaking ties. Generated inference shares history preprocessing and uses posterior means. All four dataset routes and supplied splits are preserved.
